ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Rust Cathedral Walls
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUST_CATHEDRAL_MECHANICS_1 §2 (wall-tier mining defs — the wall ladder). Builds the four-tier economy the_rust_cathedral.md §5/§7 promises: endless deck plate anyone may strip, seams of dead smartsteel worth real trade, a sacred tier that costs goodwill to touch, and — deepest — metal that is still live, which only the drill finds.
- RUT_CathedralDeckPlate (Tier 1): mineable wall, ParentName RockBase, yields vanilla Steel at 35/cell, unowned — zero goodwill, zero hum input. - RUT_MineableDeadSmartsteel / RUT_DeadSmartsteel (Tier 2): mineable wall yielding a new resource, 25/cell, MarketValue 8. DECIDED AT BUILD (the spec's own ❓): trade-commodity only, not stuff-capable — see the item's file header for why. - RUT_SacredWall_Conduit (Tier 3): one sacred wall variant (v1 scope; more are explicitly deferred to a content pass), spawned owned by the vanilla `Mechanoid` faction (the Forgotten/Forsaken Arsenal reskin, Patches/ForgottenArsenal.xml in mandrake.rut.patches) — NOT mineable. Destroying or claiming it costs goodwill via vanilla's own AttackedBuilding hook, engine-default on any faction-owned building, no new code needed for that part. The −15 magnitude and the hum-irritation bump both ride §1 (hum-mood system), not yet built — noted, not stubbed. - RUT_LivePatternMetal (Tier 4): a deep-drill-only resource. Vanilla's weighted deep-resource pick (CompDeepScanner.ChooseLumpThingDef) has no biome axis at all, so a small Harmony postfix substitutes vanilla Steel for this def whenever the scanning map is not the Rust Cathedral — the one place this pass could not stay at "zero new C#" the spec hoped for (same category of small, necessary deviation as the biome-gated GenStep subclasses below).
Placement: RUT_RustCathedral's BiomeDef gains a `forceRockTypes` entry (Tiers 1+2 — the same vanilla field Alpha Biomes' own donor def used for its now-absent GU_AncientMetals, read from vendor/mod_sources/AlphaBiomes_src) so any vanilla rock-formation code that runs on Cathedral maps uses these walls instead of default granite. Because the biome is 211/236 tiles dead flat, forceRockTypes alone is not proven sufficient density, so a small self-gating GenStep_ScatterGroup subclass (the same convention as FungalSoilTrade's GenStep_ScatterFungalGround and LanternDeeps' GenStep_ScatterCavePortal — "GenStepDef has no biome field and vanilla ships no ScattererValidator_Biome") guarantees baseline coverage of Tiers 1/2 and places the one Tier 3 variant, gated on map.Biome.defName == "RUT_RustCathedral", added to the shared MapCommonBase genSteps list so it no-ops on every other biome's maps.
Deferred (kit spec's own v1 line): the "rarer, stranger wall types" beyond one sacred wall variant (content pass, art-hungry), wall-linked art atlases (rides the art pipe — every texPath below is placeholder, reusing vanilla's RockFlecked_Atlas). §1/§3/§4/§5 of the kit are untouched by this mod.
